messages: olivia: Heads-up: Docusaurus export failed in the nightly docs build with a "DuplicateFragmentError" pointing at /guides/integrations. olivia: Build log excerpt: "Error: found empty fragment identifier while resolving anchors in page /guides/integrations" raj: Any idea which file? olivia: pages/guides/integrations.mdx — a recent PR added an inline HTML anchor to try to set a manual fragment but the id was left blank. Snippet: ``` ## Integrations ``` jamie: Ahh, an empty id attribute. Slugifier sees that as an explicit empty fragment and the resolver bails. I haven't seen that exact error before. raj: Quick fixes: remove the empty anchor, or give it a real id like ``, or add `slug:` to frontmatter. olivia: I'm going to open a tiny PR to remove the HTML anchor and add an explicit `slug: guides-integrations` in the frontmatter to keep links stable. docs-bot: @olivia opened PR #3182 — "docs: remove empty inline anchor in integrations page + add frontmatter slug" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3182 ci-bot: docs CI started for PR #3182 — running docusaurus build and linkcheck ci-bot: docusaurus build ✅ for PR #3182 — no anchor errors raj: Nice. Can we add a quick lint in CI to flag empty id attributes in MDX? It's an easy regex and would have caught this. jamie: Agreed. Also worth adding a CONTRIBUTING note: avoid raw HTML anchors unless strictly necessary; prefer frontmatter `slug` or heading-level normalization. olivia: Added a CONTRIBUTING blurb and filed issue #127 to add an MDX linter rule that rejects `id=""` and other empty anchor usages. docs-bot: @olivia filed issue #127 — "docs: lint MDX for empty HTML anchors and forbid blank id attributes" raj: Merged PR and promoted to staging. Verified deep links work and no missing fragments. olivia: Thanks — closing this thread.
